notes.title: bug repair
notes.content:
修复 卡牌游戏后枪支无法捡起的bug
修复 存档导致意外卡死的bug
待修复bug和待完成作业
1.卡牌游戏存档会无法进行卡牌游戏
2.剩下5个小游戏(无限制延期...未来开发新作会用这些小游戏做实验玩法，但由于这款游戏销量不甚理想，目前我正在做一款slg，同类型游戏也是无限制延期)
最后感谢各位支持，这款游戏，断断续续更新了一年了，我的工作将会投入另外一款slg游戏上，后续有多余bug，也会继续更新的，未来或许还是会慢慢把这款游戏补完，非常感谢大家

Fixed a bug where guns could not be picked up after card games
Fixed a bug where saving caused accidental card death
Bugs to be fixed and jobs to be completed
1. Card game save will not be able to play card game
2. 5 minigames left (unlimited delay... The future development of new games will use these small games as experimental play, but because the sales of this game is not satisfactory, I am currently working on a slg, the same type of game is also unlimited delay)
Finally, thank you for your support, this game has been updated intermittently for a year, my work will be invested in another slg game, there are additional bugs, will continue to update, the future may still slowly complete this game, thank you very much

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.3.1
notes.content:
更新公告 - 版本 1.3.1

尊敬的玩家，

感谢您对这款由我个人开发的游戏的支持！倾听了您的反馈后，我进行了大量的改进和游戏

更新内容：

比较大幅度游戏画面效果
优化了游戏中的一些界面，使操作更加流畅。
新增了一个简短而令人兴奋的小游戏 - 回家
希望您在这次更新后能够更加愉快地玩游戏。如果您有任何建议或反馈，请随时告诉我。

祝您玩得开心！


Patch Notes - Version 1.3.1

Dear player,

Thank you for supporting this game developed by me personally! After listening to your feedback, I have made a series of improvements and fixes to enhance the overall gaming experience.

Patch Highlights:Improved game graphics significantly, optimizing various interfaces for smoother gameplay. Added a short yet exciting mini-game called "Going Home." Hope you enjoy playing even more after this update. Feel free to share any suggestions or feedback with me.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
更新公告 - 版本 1.2.1

尊敬的玩家，

感谢您对这款由我个人开发的游戏的支持！倾听了您的反馈后，我进行了一系列的改进和修复，以提供更好的游戏体验。

更新内容：

修复了一些影响游戏稳定性的bug，提升了整体性能。
优化了游戏中的一些界面，使操作更加流畅。
新增了一个简短而令人兴奋的小游戏 - "Mono在火星"！现在，您可以与Mono一起在火星上开发游戏，挑战各种有趣的开发任务。
希望您在这次更新后能够更加愉快地玩游戏。如果您有任何建议或反馈，请随时告诉我。

祝您玩得开心！


Patch Notes - Version 1.2.1

Dear player,

Thank you for supporting this game developed by me personally! After listening to your feedback, I have made a series of improvements and fixes to enhance the overall gaming experience.

Patch Highlights:

Fixed several bugs affecting game stability and enhanced overall performance.
Optimized some interfaces in the game for smoother gameplay.
Introducing a short and exciting mini-game - "Mono on Mars"! Now, you can join Mono in developing a game on Mars, tackling various fun development tasks.
I hope you enjoy the game even more after this update. If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to let me know.

Happy gaming!
